name: dunesight
description: DuneSight: a 3D globe that tracks sand-dune migration west of Al Ain from NASA Landsat, HLS, MERRA-2 and NASADEM data.

scripts.postbuild: node -e "const fs=require('fs');if(fs.existsSync('dist/dunesight/cesium')){fs.rmSync('dist/cesium',{recursive:true,force:true});fs.renameSync('dist/dunesight/cesium','dist/cesium');fs.rmSync('dist/dunesight',{recursive:true,force:true});console.log('postbuild: moved dist/dunesight/cesium -> dist/cesium (vite-plugin-cesium base-path quirk)')}"
scripts.pipeline: cd pipeline && .venv/bin/jupyter nbconvert --to notebook --execute --inplace 01_scenes_and_wind.ipynb && .venv/bin/jupyter nbconvert --to notebook --execute --inplace 02_tracking_and_dunes.ipynb && .venv/bin/jupyter nbconvert --to notebook --execute --inplace 03_threats_and_frames.ipynb
